content.body:
This automatic rifle was designed by Browning for use by American soldiers in WWI. Firing the .30-06 rifle cartridge, and offering selective fire, it was intended to help soldiers in trench warfare but came to fill the role of squad light machinegun. This was enhanced by the addition of a bipod mount.
Although its 20-round capacity limited its ability to operate as a light machinegun, especially against German tactics, the Browning Automatic Rifle found more success returning to its original role of shoulder-fired automatic rifle. It was also more useful with appropriate tactics, such those developed by the US Marine Corp, which used a squad of three four-man teams, one BAR per team.
content.brief: WEAPON: M1918A2 Browning Automatic Rifle AMMO: .30-06 cal (7.62 mm) MAGAZINE: 20 rounds in box magazine MUZZLE VELOCITY: 860 m/s RATE OF FIRE: 500 rpm OTHER EQUIPMENT: M1911A1 Automatic Pistol .45 cal Combat Knife
